whim.definition:
n a sudden desire
n an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
whim.translation: n. 一时的兴致, 冲动, 怪念头, 绞盘

whimbrel.definition:
n. Any one of several species of small curlews, especially
   the European species (Numenius phaeopus), called also Jack curlew, half
   curlew, stone curlew, and tang whaup. See Illustration in Appendix.

whimling.definition:
n. One given to whims; hence, a weak, childish person; a
   child.
whimling.translation: n. 孩子气的人, 懦弱的人, 异想天开的人

whimmy.translation: a. 异想天开的,心血来潮的

whimper.definition: n. a complaint uttered in a plaintive whining way
whimper.translation:
n. 抽泣, 呜咽, 啜泣, 哭诉
vi. 呜咽, 啜泣, 抽噎地哭
vt. 呜咽着说, 啜泣着说

whimpered.translation: v. （微弱或惊恐地）啜泣, 呜咽( whimper的过去式和过去分词 ); 啜泣或呜咽着说

whimperer.translation: n. 啜泣者, 呜咽者, 抱怨者

whimpering.translation: v. （微弱或惊恐地）啜泣, 呜咽( whimper的现在分词 ); 啜泣或呜咽着说; 幽咽

whimperings.definition:
plural of whimpering
v cry weakly or softly
whimperings.translation: (whimpering 的复数) v. （微弱或惊恐地）啜泣, 呜咽( whimper的现在分词 ); 啜泣或呜咽着说; 幽咽

whimpers.definition:
n a complaint uttered in a plaintive whining way
v cry weakly or softly
whimpers.translation:
n. 啜泣声, 呜咽声( whimper的名词复数 ); 啜泣者
v. （微弱或惊恐地）啜泣, 呜咽( whimper的第三人称单数 ); 啜泣或呜咽着说

whimple.definition:
v. t. See Wimple.
v. i. To whiffle; to veer.

whims.definition:
n. a sudden desire
n. an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
whims.translation: n. 一时的兴致( whim的复数形式 ); 突然的念头; 突发奇想; 异想天开

whimsey.definition:
n an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
n the trait of acting unpredictably and more from whim or caprice than from reason or judgment

whimsical.definition: s determined by chance or impulse or whim rather than by necessity or reason
whimsical.translation: a. 怪念头多的, 反复无常的, 古怪的, 异想天开的

whimsicalities.definition:
plural of whimsicality
n the trait of acting unpredictably and more from whim or caprice than from reason or judgment
n the trait of behaving like an imp
whimsicalities.translation: (whimsicality 的复数) n. 心血来潮, 奇异, 异想天开的想法

whimsicality.definition:
n the trait of acting unpredictably and more from whim or caprice than from reason or judgment
n the trait of behaving like an imp
whimsicality.translation: n. 心血来潮, 奇异, 异想天开的想法

whimsically.translation: adv. 异想天开地; 反复无常地; 古怪地; 奇形怪状地

whimsicalness.definition:
n. The quality or state of being whimsical;
   freakishness; whimsical disposition.

whimsied.translation: a. 想入非非的, 充满怪念头的, 异想天开的

whimsies.translation: n. 怪念头( whimsy的名词复数 ); 异想天开; 怪脾气; 与众不同的幽默感

whimsy.definition:
n an odd or fanciful or capricious idea
n the trait of acting unpredictably and more from whim or caprice than from reason or judgment
whimsy.translation: n. 怪念头, 离奇的东西, 反复无常, 绞盘

whimwham.definition:
n. A whimsical thing; an odd device; a trifle; a trinket; a
   gimcrack.
n. A whim, or whimsey; a freak.
whimwham.translation: n. 奇异的小装饰品；古怪的小玩艺儿；幻想,空想,奇想,怪念头 [参较flimflam,jimjams 等]
